title: asks.answer
description: Answers one ask. The first valid answer wins; an invalid one is bad_request, reason bad_answer, and leaves the ask open; an ask already ended is already_resolved (an evicted one included), an id never issued unknown_ask.

answer.description: An answer, each kind reading its own members and refusing any other kind's. permission: optionId, the exact id of an offered option (never a kind), or cancel. question: answers (each question's id to the option ids chosen), or skip; a question that asks nothing takes {}. plan: exactly one of accept and reject.
